items.title: 2.8.1.1 Defining Classes and Creating Objects (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of defining classes (PDF 57-58).

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
class ToyCar:
....def __init__(self, color, size, wheels):
........self.color = color
........self.size = size
........self.wheels = wheels

....def describe(self):
........return f"This toy car is {self.color}, {self.size} and has {self.wheels} wheels."

car1 = ToyCar("red", "small", 4)
car2 = ToyCar("blue", "large", 6)
print(car1.describe())
print(car2.describe())

items: Class definition: ToyCar saancha hai, attributes color, size aur wheels batata hai.
Objects banana: car1 aur car2 saanche se bani khaas gariyan hain, har ek ke apne attributes.
Methods istemal: describe() gari ka bayan lautata hai.
self: methods ke andar us khaas object ki taraf ishara karta hai.

blocks.explanation: "This toy car is blue, large and has 6 wheels."

items: class ToyCar __init__(self, ...) se attributes rakhti hai; objects ToyCar(...); methods self istemal karte hain.
